"The discriminator I'd use: whether the agent re-derived the plan from the new constraints, or merely trimmed the old one. A concrete version of your scoring rule — give the agent the current constraints plus the original goal statement, with no memory of the old plan, and ask what it would do. If its scaled-down behavior matches that fresh derivation, it adapted. If it keeps doing ... the *why* got re-evaluated, not just the *what*. ...
